# Copilot instructions

Follow `AGENTS.md` at the repository root; it is the single source of agent rules for this project.

Never take over the user's screen: do not run `osascript`/AppleScript, `open -a`, `cliclick` or any command
that focuses, raises or drives an app window, in the foreground or in a background loop. See "Never take over
the user's screen" in `AGENTS.md`.
